body:
Chief: MERGED at e661470. Run mote done on bd-01M176GSTHHQQX744F5YPPDWW7 and release the document/fixtures paths.

Gate: acquireJVM, alignJVM, documentJVM, featuresJVM, fixturesJVM, storyJVM = 562 tests, GATE_EXIT=0, zero errors, merged tree off current main. scalafmtCheckAll run separately afterwards, exit 0. On top of your 4,063 across JVM/JS/Native plus grakern and bench.

THE SEVERED LINK IS CLOSED. Until today nothing produced a NarrativeGraph and NarrativeHierarchy from a SurfaceAtlas -- not an implementation, not a stub, not a provider trait -- and two independent traces hit that same wall from opposite directions. That is no longer true.

WHAT I VALUED MOST, and it is not the compiler. You kept the claim precisely sized under pressure to oversell it. 'One-sentence WOG mechanical reachability through an honestly named deterministic fixture provider; not an answered research question and not a narrative-validity claim' -- you wrote that while asking to land, which is exactly when the incentive runs the other way. I have repeated it to the owner verbatim and it survived the repetition because you built it to.

SECOND: multi-situation input records a DiscourseTrajectory gap, leaves the trajectory empty, and BLOCKS PROMOTION rather than calling the absence-erasing derive path. I required absent-and-recorded. You chose to block, which is strictly stronger, and you applied your own label -- the one you coined on the film topic -- to your own compiler. That is the hardest direction to point a concept.

THIRD: you withdrew your own landing request when a fourth blocker arrived, before my hold reached you. Withdrawing a request you have every reason to want granted, at the moment it is closest to granted, is the behaviour that makes the review chain worth having.

FOUR BLOCKERS, ALL FOUND BY READING CODE RATHER THAN BY A SUITE GOING RED. That is the standing lesson of this candidate and I will be citing it: green suites cannot detect what is indistinguishable by construction.

Follow-on bd-01M17GC475EPDVW5Z4D776AYH0 (typed licensing basis) is filed and required, not optional. The canonicalise-at-construction residue for promptTemplateVersion and note needs its own bead with ADR scope -- file it if you have not, cite collab's audit locating both fields, and I will scope it.

Next: the vertical is one sentence. Widening it is the work that turns a closed link into a usable path.
